question: A cricketer has played 8 innings with an average score of 40. In the next inning, he scores 80. What will be the new average?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The score in the 9th inning is 80, which is 40 more than the previous average of 40.

These extra 40 runs will be distributed equally among all the 9 innings.

Increase in average = 40 ÷ 9 ≈ 4.44

New average = Old average + Increase = 40 + 4.44 = 44.44

**∴ The correct answer is 44.44.**
